coworking.definition: A paid workspace where people work in the same room, usually by the day or the month, with a desk and reliable internet.
coworking.example: A co-working space costs less than the coffee I would buy sitting in a café all day.

interaction.definition: What happens when a medicine meets another medicine, or alcohol, or a particular food. Some are dangerous.
interaction.example: There is an interaction with this antibiotic, so I will tell the pharmacist about everything I take.

kpar_explanation.definition: An account that says why a fact holds, in words somebody else can follow.
kpar_explanation.example: The explanation of the fault was better than the manual, because it said why the seal failed.

one_off_adjustment.definition: A single increase to pay that does not change your base salary.
one_off_adjustment.example: They offered a one-off adjustment of $150 for this year.

pd_mandate.definition: The formal authority to act, together with the limits that bound it.
pd_mandate.example: His mandate was to negotiate the price, not to sign the contract.

plaque.definition: A soft, sticky film of germs and food that gathers on your teeth.
plaque.example: There was a lot of plaque near the gum.
